entries.instruction: Grab the bottle with yellow sticker label and shake it.
Pick up the gray bottle for holding drinks and shake it.
Grab the bottle with green label and white lid and give it a shake.
Use the left arm to grab the light gray bottle and shake.
Use the left arm to pick the yellow bottle for liquid storage.
Pick up the bottle with red screw cap and shake it.
Use the right arm to grab the yellow bottle for liquid storage and shake.
Use the right arm to grab the gray bottle for holding drinks and shake.
Use the right arm to grab the bottle with ridged orange grip and shake.
Use the left arm to grab the lightweight plastic brown bottle and shake.
Use the left arm to grab the bottle with curved neck design and shake.
Shake the brown bottle after picking it with the left arm.
Use the left arm to pick the bottle with red screw cap.
Shake the bottle with glossy surface after picking it with the left arm.
Pick up the hand-sized yellow plastic bottle and shake it.
Shake the brown bottle after picking it with the right arm.
Pick and shake the the plastic bottle with blue label with the right arm.
Grab the gray bottle for holding drinks, shake it properly, then set it down.
Grab the curvy orange bottle with white section, shake it properly, then set it down.
Pick up the bottle with ridged orange grip and shake it.
